title: Phrase Velocity
description: Message counts over time for the eight most-used normalized phrases in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT
    event_time,
    BTRIM(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(message, '[^[:alnum:]@#[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')), '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')) AS phrase
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
), top_phrases AS (
  SELECT phrase
  FROM normalized
  WHERE phrase <> ''
  GROUP BY phrase
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, phrase
  LIMIT 8
)
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(n.event_time, $__interval),
  LEFT(n.phrase, 80) AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM normalized n
JOIN top_phrases t USING (phrase)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

title: Cross-Channel Meme Migration
description: Tracks a normalized phrase's first appearance in successive channels and the delay between arrivals.

targets.rawSql:
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT
    event_time,
    event_time AT TIME ZONE '${timezone}' AS local_time,
    channel_name,
    BTRIM(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(message, '[^[:alnum:]@#[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')), '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')) AS phrase
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
), per_channel AS (
  SELECT
    phrase,
    channel_name,
    MIN(event_time) AS first_seen,
    MIN(local_time) AS first_seen_local,
    COUNT(*) AS occurrences
  FROM normalized
  WHERE phrase <> ''
  GROUP BY phrase, channel_name
), eligible AS (
  SELECT phrase
  FROM per_channel
  GROUP BY phrase
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
     AND SUM(occurrences) >= 3
), ordered AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    LAG(channel_name) OVER (PARTITION BY phrase ORDER BY first_seen, channel_name) AS previous_channel,
    LAG(first_seen) OVER (PARTITION BY phrase ORDER BY first_seen, channel_name) AS previous_seen
  FROM per_channel p
  JOIN eligible e USING (phrase)
)
SELECT
  LEFT(phrase, 100) AS "Phrase",
  previous_channel AS "From",
  channel_name AS "To",
  TO_CHAR(first_seen_local, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Arrival",
  ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (first_seen - previous_seen)) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Lag (minutes)",
  occurrences AS "Messages at destination"
FROM ordered
WHERE previous_channel IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY first_seen, phrase, channel_name
LIMIT 50

title: Lexical Diversity by Channel
description: Distinct words as a percentage of all words used by each selected channel.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT channel_name, message
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
), tokens AS (
  SELECT s.channel_name, t.token
  FROM selected s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(
    lower(regexp_replace(s.message, '[^[:alnum:]_]+', ' ', 'g')),
    '[[:space:]]+'
  ) AS t(token)
  WHERE LENGTH(t.token) >= 2
)
SELECT
  channel_name AS "Channel",
  ROUND((100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT token) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Lexical diversity"
FROM tokens
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY "Lexical diversity" DESC, "Channel"

title: Novelty Score Over Time
description: Percentage of each bucket's vocabulary first observed in that channel during the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT event_time, channel_name, message
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
), tokens AS (
  SELECT s.event_time, s.channel_name, t.token
  FROM selected s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(
    lower(regexp_replace(s.message, '[^[:alnum:]_]+', ' ', 'g')),
    '[[:space:]]+'
  ) AS t(token)
  WHERE LENGTH(t.token) >= 2
), first_seen AS (
  SELECT channel_name, token, MIN(event_time) AS first_seen
  FROM tokens
  GROUP BY channel_name, token
)
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(t.event_time, $__interval),
  t.channel_name AS metric,
  ROUND((
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT t.token) FILTER (
      WHERE $__timeGroup(f.first_seen, $__interval) = $__timeGroup(t.event_time, $__interval)
    ) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.token), 0)
  )::numeric, 1) AS value
FROM tokens t
JOIN first_seen f
  ON f.channel_name = t.channel_name
 AND f.token = t.token
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

title: Echo Coefficient by Channel
description: Percentage of messages repeating another user's normalized phrase within the previous 60 seconds.

targets.rawSql:
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    event_time,
    channel_name,
    COALESCE(user_id, lower(user_name)) AS actor,
    BTRIM(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(message, '[^[:alnum:]@#[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')), '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')) AS phrase
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(user_id, user_name) IS NOT NULL
), sequenced AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_name, phrase ORDER BY event_time, id) AS previous_time,
    LAG(actor) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_name, phrase ORDER BY event_time, id) AS previous_actor
  FROM normalized
  WHERE phrase <> ''
)
SELECT
  channel_name AS "Channel",
  ROUND((
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE previous_time >= event_time - INTERVAL '60 seconds'
        AND previous_actor IS DISTINCT FROM actor
    ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
  )::numeric, 1) AS "Echo coefficient"
FROM sequenced
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY "Echo coefficient" DESC, "Channel"

title: Excitement Index
description: Composite 0-100 score using uppercase, !/? density, repeated-character, and relative velocity proxies.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bucket_signals AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroupAlias(event_time, $__interval),
    channel_name,
    COUNT(*)::numeric AS messages,
    AVG(
      COALESCE(
        LENGTH(regexp_replace(message, '[^[:upper:]]', '', 'g'))::numeric
        / NULLIF(LENGTH(regexp_replace(message, '[^[:alpha:]]', '', 'g')), 0),
        0
      )
    ) AS caps_score,
    AVG(
      LEAST(
        1.0,
        LENGTH(regexp_replace(message, '[^!?]', '', 'g'))::numeric / 3.0
      )
    ) AS punctuation_score,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN message ~ '([[:alnum:]!?])\1{2,}' THEN 1.0
        ELSE 0.0
      END
    ) AS repetition_score
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    channel_name,
    caps_score,
    punctuation_score,
    repetition_score,
    messages / NULLIF(MAX(messages) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_name), 0) AS velocity_score
  FROM bucket_signals
)
SELECT
  time,
  channel_name AS metric,
  ROUND((100.0 * (
    0.30 * caps_score
    + 0.20 * punctuation_score
    + 0.20 * repetition_score
    + 0.30 * velocity_score
  ))::numeric, 1) AS value
FROM scored
ORDER BY time, metric

title: Mention Network (@username)
description: Directed edges from chatters to @usernames extracted from message text; edge weight is mention count.

targets.rawSql:
WITH mentions AS (
  SELECT
    lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_name, ''), NULLIF(e.display_name, ''), e.user_id)) AS source,
    lower(found.parts[1]) AS target
  FROM twitch_event_chat e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_matches(
    e.message,
    '@([A-Za-z0-9_]{1,25})',
    'g'
  ) AS found(parts)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_name, ''), NULLIF(e.display_name, ''), e.user_id) IS NOT NULL
), edges AS (
  SELECT source, target, COUNT(*) AS mentions
  FROM mentions
  WHERE source <> target
  GROUP BY source, target
)
SELECT
  source || '→' || target AS id,
  source,
  target,
  mentions AS mainstat
FROM edges
ORDER BY mentions DESC, source, target
LIMIT 100

title: Display-Name Evolution
description: Consecutive display-name periods for users who changed names during the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    event_time,
    event_time AT TIME ZONE '${timezone}' AS local_time,
    channel_name,
    COALESCE(user_id, lower(user_name)) AS user_key,
    user_name,
    display_name
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(user_id, user_name) IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(display_name, '') IS NOT NULL
), evolving_users AS (
  SELECT channel_name, user_key
  FROM selected
  GROUP BY channel_name, user_key
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT display_name) > 1
), marked AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    CASE
      WHEN display_name IS DISTINCT FROM LAG(display_name) OVER (
        PARTITION BY channel_name, user_key
        ORDER BY event_time, id
      ) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS starts_run
  FROM selected s
  JOIN evolving_users e USING (channel_name, user_key)
), grouped AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(starts_run) OVER (
      PARTITION BY channel_name, user_key
      ORDER BY event_time, id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS name_run
  FROM marked
)
SELECT
  channel_name AS "Channel",
  COALESCE(MAX(user_name), user_key) AS "User",
  display_name AS "Display name",
  TO_CHAR(MIN(local_time), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "From",
  TO_CHAR(MAX(local_time), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "To",
  COUNT(*) AS "Messages"
FROM grouped
GROUP BY channel_name, user_key, display_name, name_run
ORDER BY MIN(event_time) DESC, channel_name, "User"
LIMIT 100

title: Repeated-Message Ratio
description: Duplicate normalized messages as a percentage of all non-empty normalized messages per channel.

targets.rawSql:
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT
    channel_name,
    BTRIM(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(message, '[^[:alnum:]@#[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')), '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')) AS phrase
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
)
SELECT
  channel_name AS "Channel",
  ROUND((
    100.0 * (COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT phrase)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
  )::numeric, 1) AS "Repeated-message ratio"
FROM normalized
WHERE phrase <> ''
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY "Repeated-message ratio" DESC, "Channel"

title: Vocabulary Overlap by Channel
description: Pairwise channel vocabulary overlap using Jaccard similarity in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT channel_name, message
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
), vocabulary AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.channel_name, t.token
  FROM selected s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(
    lower(regexp_replace(s.message, '[^[:alnum:]_]+', ' ', 'g')),
    '[[:space:]]+'
  ) AS t(token)
  WHERE LENGTH(t.token) >= 2
), channel_sizes AS (
  SELECT channel_name, COUNT(*) AS words
  FROM vocabulary
  GROUP BY channel_name
), channel_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    a.channel_name AS channel_a,
    b.channel_name AS channel_b,
    a.words AS words_a,
    b.words AS words_b
  FROM channel_sizes a
  CROSS JOIN channel_sizes b
  WHERE a.channel_name < b.channel_name
), shared AS (
  SELECT
    a.channel_name AS channel_a,
    b.channel_name AS channel_b,
    COUNT(*) AS shared_words
  FROM vocabulary a
  JOIN vocabulary b
    ON b.token = a.token
   AND a.channel_name < b.channel_name
  GROUP BY a.channel_name, b.channel_name
)
SELECT
  p.channel_a AS "Channel A",
  p.channel_b AS "Channel B",
  COALESCE(s.shared_words, 0) AS "Shared words",
  ROUND((
    100.0 * COALESCE(s.shared_words, 0)
    / NULLIF(p.words_a + p.words_b - COALESCE(s.shared_words, 0), 0)
  )::numeric, 1) AS "Vocabulary overlap"
FROM channel_pairs p
LEFT JOIN shared s
  ON s.channel_a = p.channel_a
 AND s.channel_b = p.channel_b
ORDER BY "Vocabulary overlap" DESC, "Channel A", "Channel B"
LIMIT 100
